messages:
ashley (billing): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — token-count deltas + delayed usage ingestion still need concrete owners and timelines. Need a single checklist for customers and auditors.

mike (reconciliation): We had 34 accounts affected, several asked for corrected invoices. I can own outreach but need the corrections produced.

devin (ingest): Root cause: race in batch-merge that sporadically dropped late events. Patch in review.

jana (invoicing): Our correction flow is credit + reissue invoice per account. If devin can supply delta CSV, we can start ticketing. What format?

ashley (billing): Devin — CSV columns: customer_id, billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, delta_tokens, reason. Also include date-range.

devin (ingest): Confirmed. ETA: 48h for corrected ingestion run, +12h to produce CSV. Owner: devin. Will include sample raw_event_ids for audit.

ryan (eng-infra): Noticed job retries can clobber older merges under load. Pushing guard today to prevent dropped partitions.

ops-bot: Deploy started: ingester-service v2.4.1 -> staging at 2026-03-19T16:05:00Z

jana (invoicing): Can we do 34 manual tickets this sprint? I can do ~10. Need help splitting workload.

sara (finance): I can take 12 tickets and draft customer comms. Proposed template: "We detected an ingestion issue affecting your usage for <date-range>. We issued a credit of $X and reissued the invoice."

mike (reconciliation): Template looks good. Internal tag: adjustment_reason=INGESTION_LAG_2026-03 so analytics can filter.

ashley (billing): Action items: A1: per-account delta CSV (owner: devin, due: 2026-03-21 16:00 UTC); A2: harden retry guard (owner: ryan, due: 2026-03-19 23:59 UTC); A3: create comms + run 34 correction tickets (owners: jana+sara+mike, due: 2026-03-25); A4: tag corrected invoices with adjustment_reason (owner: mike, due: 2026-03-25); A5: weekly audit query x8 weeks (owner: ashley, start 2026-03-28 weekly).

devin (ingest): I'll add checksum column and place CSV in secure S3. Will share link here.

ryan (eng-infra): Mitigation pushed to prod; will post PR link. If anomalies persist, escalate to rollback.

jana (invoicing): I'll split tickets and mark enterprise/disputed priorities.

mike (reconciliation): Will flag disputed and enterprise accounts.

ashley (billing): Process notes: 1) Post short internal status doc in #finance and link it in comms if customers ask. 2) Avoid bulk corrections without per-account ticket traces for auditors.

sara (finance): Drafting internal status doc after CSV. Will include table with accounts, amounts, ticket IDs.

ops-bot: CI test failed for ingester-service PR #482 — batch-merge test flakiness.

devin (ingest): If CI blocks rollout, I'll run manual ingestion and lock the cluster for the corrected window, then annotate manual run in status doc.

ashley (billing): Before close we need: final corrected token total, number of invoices adjusted, aggregate credit amount, and confirmation retry guard is live. Update thread when done.

ryan (eng-infra): Will post PR + prod flag link when live.

devin (ingest): CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/private/ingest-adjustments/1767204321-deltas.csv — setting ACLs.

jana (invoicing): Received CSV, starting ticketing.

sara (finance): Uploaded comms template + status doc stub, linking here.

mike (reconciliation): Updating analytics tags after tickets created.

ashley (billing): Thanks all. We'll review closure in the weekly billing postmortem on 2026-03-25. If anything slips, ping @ashley (billing). :thumbsup:
